I rewrote the test at `cli/src/lib/core-manifest.test.ts` so it no longer writes to the shared system tmp directory. That write was what CodeQL flagged at the lines 451 and 460 write calls.

The test now makes a private scratch directory with `makeTmpDir` and sets `TMPDIR` to it. It re-imports `core-manifest.js` fresh, so the module's `OS_SCRATCH_ROOT` constant picks up that directory. It then puts the stray `core-manifest.json` and the fixture inside the private directory and asserts `findTemplateRoot` returns null. `TMPDIR` and the module cache are restored in `finally`. The test is now `async`, and I added `vi` to the vitest import. I also removed the `existsSync`, `readFileSync` and `tmpdir` imports, which nothing uses any more.

I ran `npx vitest run src/lib/core-manifest.test.ts` and all 47 tests pass. `npx eslint` on the test file is clean and `npx tsc --noEmit` reported nothing. I did not re-run CodeQL, so the alerts closing is unconfirmed. The test no longer contains any write to the real tmp root, which is what those alerts flagged.

VERDICT: FIXED
